observations.body: The LORD recalls loving Israel as a child and calling the son from Egypt, yet the more Israel was called the more the people turned to Baals.
observations.label: Israel is remembered as a loved child who turned away: action

observations.body: compassion recoils against total destruction, and return is pictured after a lion-like roar.
observations.label: Israel is remembered as a loved child who turned away: response

payload.posture: Read Hosea 11:1–11 as prophets accuse and promise evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Parental love, persistent apostasy, threatened conquest, and refused total destruction remain in one divine speech.
payload.title: Israel is remembered as a loved child who turned away
